slides.texte_overlay:
How to become the guy
people feel safe around
Keep your reactions steady. When someone shares bad news or a mistake, stay calm first. People open up to the man who doesn't explode when things go wrong.
Never repeat what people tell you in confidence. Not even as a funny story. Being a vault for other people's worries is the foundation of real trust.
Listen without judging. "That sounds hard, tell me more." Holding back your opinion for a moment shows people they can be completely honest with you.
Be kind to people who can't do anything for you. Waiters, kids, strangers. Everyone watches how you treat others and decides if you're safe to be close to.
Bring calm into the room. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and a curious, settled mind makes me easier to be around when life gets loud.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. A curious, settled mind makes me easier to be around when life gets loud.

slides.texte_overlay: Respect boundaries the first time. A no is a no, a closed door stays closed. People relax around a man who never pushes past what they're comfortable with.
Admit when you're wrong. "You were right, I'm sorry." A man who can say this easily feels safe, because people know he won't fight to win at any cost.
